ai_summary: D. P. Abhushan Limited inaugurated its first Franchisee Owned Company Operated (FOCO) showroom in Jabalpur, marking its 14th overall retail outlet. This new model allows for capital-light expansion, with the franchise partner funding inventory and capital expenditure, enabling the company to expand its reach while retaining operational control and leveraging a revenue-sharing agreement. However, this is explicitly a pilot program, indicating a cautious approach to assessing its operational effectiveness and scalability before considering a wider rollout, which limits its immediate material impact to a single store.
